name: WAGMI
description: The WAGMI protocol is a limited TVL decentralized exchange with advanced liquidity provision strategies and GMI mechanics. The WAGMI protocol is designed to maximize the utilization of liquidity under management, optimizing returns for liquidity providers. WAGMI is live on Kava, zkSync Era and Fantom.

methodology.UserFees: LPs collect 100% of the fee generated in a pool
methodology.Fees: Fees generated on each swap at a rate set by the pool.
methodology.Revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
